checklist.text: Fire walls and separations, and whether openings in them are protected
Walls, roof, frame and floors, with their materials and combustibility; building age, height and any alterations
Each building's construction class, floor area, storeys and year built
Combustible roof or wall panels, insulation and linings, and where they are
Sprinkler system types, coverage and design density for each area
Each fire pump's type, driver, rating and controller
Where alarms are monitored, and how quickly they are acted on
The latest pump flow test results
Gaseous, foam or other special systems, and what they protect
Water sources, tanks and mains feeding the fire protection
Check server and comms rooms: separation, detection and suppression

observations.note: office partitions drywall - gypsum, alu studs, rockwool infill
link to next bldg at B2 carpark, 2hr fire shutter. link not used, shutter perm shut

so the office floors are open plan, no separation within a floor except the utility rooms. elec rooms are 2 hour walls and floors with 2 hour doors, and every elec room we went into had the cable penetrations sealed
telecom risers triple vol, fire stopped every 3 flrs - the ones we saw ok. riser doors 1hr
internal stairs L27-29, L34-35, L40-41, L45-46. smoke det activated 2hr roller shutters round each stair
wet pipe sprinklers throughout incl car park, OH1 office / OH2 carpark. sprinkler tanks B3 2 x 300 m3. jockey + duty elec + standby diesel pump
few sprinkler heads recessed >50% into ceiling at B3 service corridor - obstructs spray pattern. FM said ceiling was lowered last yr
addressable fire alarm, monitored 24/7 by FCC on L1, direct link to SCDF. hose reels + extinguishers every floor, wet riser
weekly pump churn test logs ok but last annual flow test record not available. diesel pump fuel tank 3/4 full
fire door sequencer at B2 service lift corridor not working. fire door inspection not in maintenance schedule
few spk heads recessed more than 50% into ceiling at B3 service corridor
FA panel normal, no isolations, monitored by central station

label_fixes.reason: The note records the fire alarm panel's state (normal, no isolations) and its monitoring, which is fire alarm detail.
The note records the partition linings and insulation (gypsum drywall, rockwool infill), so it says whether linings and insulation are combustible.
